text: I feel disoriented, the repetition of 'I'm a lawyer' echoes and reverberates oddly in my mind as I pass through these angled, modern spaces. The bright glass walls and the loud visual stimuli of the display create a sense of displacement—am I merely passing through roles and rooms, or is there deeper meaning in my presence? I question my relation to my environment and my identity, feeling more like an observer—an outsider—than a participant, yet my awareness sharpens because of it.
